reapack.name: ClearAutomation.lua
reapack.desc: Clear automation points on selected track

metadata.description:
Deletes envelope points (Volume, Pan, Width) from the selected track.
MODES: - Between : inside the time selection - Left : to the left of the selection - Right : to the right of the selection - Outside : everything outside the selection - Whole : the entire track
HOW TO USE: 1. Select a track in REAPER 2. Make a time selection on the timeline 3. Run the script 4. Choose the mode and envelopes to clear 5. Click CLEAR
Requires ReaImGui.

reapack.name: RandomAutomation.lua
reapack.desc: Random automation generator for selected track

metadata.description:
Generates random automation points on Volume, Pan and/or Width envelopes within the time selection.
PARAMETERS: - Enable/disable Pan, Volume, Width - Number of points to generate - Auto or manual spacing (in seconds) - Pan amplitude (%) - Volume min/max values (dB) - Width amplitude (%)
HOW TO USE: 1. Select a track 2. Make a time selection 3. Run the script 4. Set the parameters in the dialog 5. Click OK to generate (window stays open to run again)
No ReaImGui required.

reapack.name: ExtendItems.lua
reapack.desc: Extend item edge to a target position

metadata.description:
Moves the left or right edge of selected items to a precise position.
TARGET POSITIONS: - Timeline Zero : moves the edge to 0:00 - Timecode : enter minutes / seconds / centiseconds manually - Bar number : enter a bar number
HOW TO USE: 1. Select one or more items on the timeline 2. Run the script 3. Choose which edge to extend (left or right) 4. Choose the target position 5. Click EXTEND
Built-in Undo/Redo button included. Requires ReaImGui.

reapack.name: TemplatePicker.lua
reapack.desc: Project template picker with search bar

metadata.description:
Browse and quickly load a REAPER project template from a searchable list.
HOW TO USE: 1. Run the script 2. Use the search bar to filter templates 3. Click a template to select it 4. Click OPEN or double-click the name
CONFIGURATION: The script auto-detects your REAPER ProjectTemplates folder. If it does not work, edit TEMPLATE_PATH at the top of the file: Windows : "C:\\Users\\YOUR_NAME\\AppData\\Roaming\\REAPER\\ProjectTemplates\\" macOS : os.getenv("HOME") .. "/Library/Application Support/REAPER/ProjectTemplates/"
Requires ReaImGui.

Navigate a short film project folder structure and open .rpp files directly.
EXPECTED FOLDER STRUCTURE: SHORT_FILMS/ MY_FILM_C1/ (project folder, suffix _CX) MY_FILM_Zik/ (music folder, suffix _Zik) scene01A/ (scene folder) scene01A.rpp
CONFIGURATION: Edit court_metrage_path at the top of the file: Windows : "D:\\MY_PROJECTS\\SHORT_FILMS" macOS : "/Users/your_name/Projects/Short_Films"
Requires ReaImGui.

reapack.name: MixMasterCheatSheet.lua
reapack.desc: Mix and mastering cheat sheet by instrument and genre

metadata.description:
Reference interface with recommended EQ, compression and reverb settings for each instrument, organized by musical genre.
GENRES: Rock, Hip-Hop, Jazz, Electronic, and more. INSTRUMENTS: Drums (Kick, Snare, Hi-Hats, Overhead, Toms), Bass, Guitars, Vocals, Keys.
HOW TO USE: 1. Run the script 2. Select the musical genre 3. Browse by instrument to see EQ / Compressor / Reverb suggestions
This is a reference tool — values are starting points, not rules. Trust your ears!
Requires ReaImGui.
